{'text': "Twelve South is a company that makes a range of premium Apple accessories, and its AirFly brand is getting a major expansion today. The company just announced AirFly Drive, an adapter that turns wired CarPlay into wireless CarPlay, and it's available to order starting today for $39.99. Here's how it works.", 'tts': 'Twelve South 係一間推出多款高階 Apple 配件嘅公司，旗下 AirFly 品牌今次有重大擴充。該公司今日發表 AirFly Drive，一款可以將有線 CarPlay 變成無線 CarPlay 嘅轉接器，即日起接受預訂，售價 39.99 美元。以下係佢嘅運作原理。', 'translation_style': 'news'}

{'text': 'Twelve South says AirFly Drive works with most cars that have factory wired CarPlay, covering over 75 auto brands and model years from 2014 onward. AirFly Drive uses a USB-A plug, but Twelve South includes a USB-C adapter in the box. It uses a small aluminum design meant to stay plugged in.', 'tts': 'Twelve South 表示，AirFly Drive 適用於大部分配備原廠有線 CarPlay 嘅車款，涵蓋 2014 年起、超過 75 個汽車品牌及型號年份。AirFly Drive 本身採用 USB-A 插頭，但 Twelve South 隨盒附送 USB-C 轉接器。佢採用細小嘅鋁合金設計，適合長期插住使用。', 'translation_style': 'news'}

{'text': "Twelve South's AirFly Drive doesn't require any apps or accounts. Users just plug it into their car's USB port, pair it with their phone once, and that's it. After that, AirFly Drive will automatically reconnect every time they get in the car for a wireless CarPlay experience. It also supports pairing with two phones at once, with a single button to switch between them.", 'tts': 'Twelve South 嘅 AirFly Drive 唔需要任何應用程式或帳戶。用戶只需將佢插入汽車嘅 USB 插孔，同手機配對一次即可完成設定。之後每次上車，AirFly Drive 都會自動重新連接手機，提供無線 CarPlay 體驗。佢亦支援同時配對兩部手機，只需透過單一按鈕即可切換。', 'translation_style': 'news'}

{'text': 'Twelve South lists the following specs and features:', 'tts': 'Twelve South 列出部分規格及功能：', 'translation_style': 'news'}

  • {'text': "Wirelessly use Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on your car's existing display.", 'tts': '喺汽車原有顯示屏上使用無線 Apple CarPlay 及 Android Auto。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': 'Plug and play, no apps, accounts, or charging required.', 'tts': '即插即用，無需應用程式、帳戶或充電。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': 'Quickly reconnects automatically each time you start your car.', 'tts': '每次啟動汽車即可快速自動重新連接。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': 'Switch between two paired phones with the push of a button.', 'tts': '一按即可喺兩部已配對手機之間切換。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': 'Small aluminum housing designed to stay plugged in.', 'tts': '細小嘅鋁合金外殼，設計為長期插住使用。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': 'Supports USB-A and USB-C, with a USB-A to USB-C adapter included in the box.', 'tts': '支援 USB-A 及 USB-C，隨盒附送 USB-A 轉 USB-C 轉接器。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': "Works with your car's existing display, buttons, and steering wheel controls.", 'tts': '兼容汽車原有嘅顯示屏、按鈕及軚盤控制。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
  • {'text': 'Ongoing compatibility updates.', 'tts': '持續提供兼容性更新。', 'translation_style': 'news'}

{'text': 'Wireless CarPlay is a lot smoother than wired, especially for short trips around the city. This is a really practical upgrade for the CarPlay experience.', 'tts': '無線 CarPlay 比有線 CarPlay 順暢得多，尤其適合喺市區短途行車。對提升 CarPlay 使用體驗嚟講，係一個好實用嘅升級。', 'translation_style': 'news'}

{'text': 'AirFly Drive is available to order from Twelve South starting today for $39.99 in black or white. It also supports Android Auto.', 'tts': 'AirFly Drive 即日起可於 Twelve South 訂購，售價 39.99 美元，提供黑色及白色兩款。佢亦支援 Android Auto。', 'translation_style': 'news'}

{'text': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.', 'tts': '追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 同 Mastodon。', 'translation_style': 'news'}
